id: \bAlain: How could you Lysandre? Trying to destroy the world - I won't stand for it!
en: \bAlain: How could you Lysandre? Trying to destroy the world - I won't stand for it!
it: \bAlain: Come hai potuto, Elisio? Cercare di distruggere il mondo... Non lo permetterò!

id: \bLysandre: What a shame that you're leaving us. Especially since we started our plan to remove all trash from this world.
en: \bLysandre: What a shame that you're leaving us.  Especially since we started our plan to remove all trash from this world.
it: \bElisio: Che peccato che tu ci lasci.  Proprio ora che abbiamo avviato il nostro piano per ripulire questo mondo da tutta la spazzatura.

id: \bWith this Zygarde nothing will be able to stop us.
en: \bWith this Zygarde nothing will be able to stop us.

id: \bLysandre: Haha. You dare oppose me? Let me show you the might of Team Flare!
en: \bLysandre: Haha. You dare oppose me? Let me show you the might of Team Flare!
it: \bElisio: Ahah. Osi opporti a me? Lascia che ti mostri la potenza del Team Flare!

id: \bLysandre: No... I refuse to admit defeat. I'll come back. I'll be stronger. You haven't seen the last of me.
en: \bLysandre: No... I refuse to admit defeat. I'll come back. I'll be stronger. You haven't seen the last of me.
it: \bElisio: No... Mi rifiuto di ammettere la sconfitta. Tornerò. Sarò più forte. Non hai ancora visto l'ultima di me.

id: \bAlain: Thank you \PN. I couldn't have done that on my own. I'm ashamed to say I ever worked for him. Let's head back now.
en: \bAlain: Thank you \PN. I couldn't have done that on my own. I'm ashamed to say I ever worked for him.  Let's head back now.
it: \bAlain: Grazie, \PN. Non ce l'avrei fatta da solo. Mi vergogno di aver mai lavorato per lui.  Ora torniamo indietro.
